units.function: CLI smoke tests asserting that access, profile, invitation, membership, instance, preference, skill and LLM commands call expected HTTP methods and paths.
units.dependencyDirection: Imports only CLI command registration, mocks global fetch and never invokes the server authorization, database or audit layers.
units.keyDataModels: Fixed company, user, invite, join and member UUIDs plus HTTP method/URL pairs.
units.lifecycle: Builds a fresh Commander program for each invocation, supplies a static board token, executes 42 commands and compares captured fetch calls.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 2/2. The suite proves route spelling and method parity only; it omits headers, request bodies, response/error semantics, role/tenant denial, redaction, confirmation, idempotency and real server integration.
units.designRationale: Detect drift between a broad operator CLI surface and server route naming with inexpensive tests.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs safe operator automation and CLI/API contract parity without creating a second manually maintained authority model.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE ONLY. Generate or validate Company OS CLI commands from the canonical OpenAPI/command schema, then add effect classification, human confirmation, stable error codes and real authorization contract tests.
units.responsibilityConflict: Instance-admin promotion, company-access changes, database backups and join/invite mutations receive no stronger assertion than reads; the test cannot prove the actor, authorization, accountable decision or resulting evidence.
evidence: 2026-08-18 focused Vitest: 2 passed via existing local binary
